1.zh: 耶和华从会幕中呼叫摩西，对他说：
1.en: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

1.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们中间若有人献供物给耶和华，要从牛群羊群中献牲畜为供物。
1.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

1.zh: 「他的供物若以牛为燔祭，就要在会幕门口献一只没有残疾的公牛，可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
1.en: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

1.zh: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭便蒙悦纳，为他赎罪。
1.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

1.zh: 他要在耶和华面前宰公牛；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，把血洒在会幕门口、坛的周围。
1.en: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

1.zh: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。
1.en: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

1.zh: 祭司亚伦的子孙要把火放在坛上，把柴摆在火上。
1.en: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

1.zh: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头并脂油摆在坛上火的柴上。
1.en: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

1.zh: 但燔祭的脏腑与腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全烧在坛上，当作燔祭，献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
1.en: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

1.zh: 「人的供物若以绵羊或山羊为燔祭，就要献上没有残疾的公羊。
1.en: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

1.zh: 要把羊宰于坛的北边，在耶和华面前；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血洒在坛的周围。
1.en: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

1.zh: 要把燔祭牲切成块子，连头和脂油，祭司就要摆在坛上火的柴上；
1.en: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

1.zh: 但脏腑与腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉献，烧在坛上。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
1.en: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

1.zh: 「人奉给耶和华的供物，若以鸟为燔祭，就要献斑鸠或是雏鸽为供物。
1.en: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

1.zh: 祭司要把鸟拿到坛前，揪下头来，把鸟烧在坛上；鸟的血要流在坛的旁边；
1.en: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

1.zh: 又要把鸟的嗉子和脏物除掉，丢在坛的东边[倒]灰的地方。
1.en: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

1.zh: 要拿着鸟的两个翅膀，把鸟撕开，只是不可撕断；祭司要在坛上、在火的柴上焚烧。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。」
1.en: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

2.zh: 「若有人献素祭为供物给耶和华，要用细面浇上油，加上乳香，
2.en: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

2.zh: 带到亚伦子孙作祭司的那里；祭司就要从细面中取出一把来，并取些油和所有的乳香，然后要把所取的这些作为纪念，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
2.en: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

2.zh: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
2.en: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

2.zh: 「若用炉中烤的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面饼，或是抹油的无酵薄饼。
2.en: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

2.zh: 若用铁鏊上做的物为素祭，就要用调油的无酵细面，
2.en: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

2.zh: 分成块子，浇上油；这是素祭。
2.en: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

2.zh: 若用煎盘做的物为素祭，就要用油与细面做成。
2.en: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

2.zh: 要把这些东西做的素祭带到耶和华面前，并奉给祭司，带到坛前。
2.en: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

2.zh: 祭司要从素祭中取出作为纪念的，烧在坛上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
2.en: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

2.zh: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙。这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
2.en: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

2.zh: 「凡献给耶和华的素祭都不可有酵；因为你们不可烧一点酵、一点蜜当作火祭献给耶和华。
2.en: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

2.zh: 这些物要献给耶和华作为初熟的供物，只是不可在坛上献为馨香的祭。
2.en: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

2.zh: 凡献为素祭的供物都要用盐调和，在素祭上不可缺了你　神立约的盐。一切的供物都要配盐而献。
2.en: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

2.zh: 若向耶和华献初熟之物为素祭，要献上烘了的禾穗子，就是轧了的新穗子，当作初熟之物的素祭。
2.en: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

2.zh: 并要抹上油，加上乳香；这是素祭。
2.en: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

2.zh: 祭司要把其中作为纪念的，就是一些轧了的禾穗子和一些油，并所有的乳香，都焚烧，是向耶和华献的火祭。」
2.en: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

3.zh: 「人献供物为平安祭，若是从牛群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的献在耶和华面前。
3.en: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

3.zh: 他要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕门口。亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血洒在坛的周围。
3.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

3.zh: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，也要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
3.en: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

3.zh: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
3.en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

3.zh: 亚伦的子孙要把这些烧在坛的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。
3.en: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

3.zh: 「人向耶和华献供物为平安祭，若是从羊群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的。
3.en: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

3.zh: 若献一只羊羔为供物，必在耶和华面前献上，
3.en: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;

3.zh: 并要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围。
3.en: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

3.zh: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨处取下，并要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
3.en: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

3.zh: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
3.en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

3.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，是献给耶和华为食物的火祭。
3.en: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

3.zh: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和华面前献上。
3.en: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

3.zh: 要按手在山羊头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围，
3.en: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

3.zh: 又把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下，献给耶和华为火祭。
3.en: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

3.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，作为馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和华的。
3.en: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.

3.zh: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要成为你们世世代代永远的定例。」
3.en: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

4.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
4.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

4.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：若有人在耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事上误犯了一件，
4.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

4.zh: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪里，就当为他所犯的罪把没有残疾的公牛犊献给耶和华为赎罪祭。
4.en: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering.

4.zh: 他要牵公牛到会幕门口，在耶和华面前按手在牛的头上，把牛宰于耶和华面前。
4.en: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before the LORD.

4.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血带到会幕，
4.en: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把指头蘸于血中，在耶和华面前对着圣所的幔子弹血七次，
4.en: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.

4.zh: 又要把些血抹在会幕内、耶和华面前香坛的四角上，再把公牛所有的血倒在会幕门口、燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 要把赎罪祭公牛所有的脂油，乃是盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
4.en: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

4.zh: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下，
4.en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

4.zh: 与平安祭公牛上所取的一样；祭司要把这些烧在燔祭的坛上。
4.en: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

4.zh: 公牛的皮和所有的肉，并头、腿、脏、腑、粪，
4.en: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

4.zh: 就是全公牛，要搬到营外洁净之地、倒灰之所，用火烧在柴上。
4.en: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

4.zh: 「以色列全会众若行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，误犯了罪，是隐而未现、会众看不出来的，
4.en: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

4.zh: 会众一知道所犯的罪就要献一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，牵到会幕前。
4.en: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 会中的长老就要在耶和华面前按手在牛的头上，将牛在耶和华面前宰了。
4.en: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

4.zh: 受膏的祭司要取些公牛的血带到会幕，
4.en: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把指头蘸于血中，在耶和华面前对着幔子弹血七次，
4.en: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil.

4.zh: 又要把些血抹在会幕内、耶和华面前坛的四角上，再把所有的血倒在会幕门口、燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

4.zh: 把牛所有的脂油都取下，烧在坛上；
4.en: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

4.zh: 收拾这牛，与那赎罪祭的牛一样。祭司要为他们赎罪，他们必蒙赦免。
4.en: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

4.zh: 他要把牛搬到营外烧了，像烧头一个牛一样；这是会众的赎罪祭。
4.en: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

4.zh: 「官长若行了耶和华—他　神所吩咐不可行的什么事，误犯了罪，
4.en: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

4.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要牵一只没有残疾的公山羊为供物，
4.en: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

4.zh: 按手在羊的头上，宰于耶和华面前、宰燔祭牲的地方；这是赎罪祭。
4.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，把血倒在燔祭坛的脚那里。
4.en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

4.zh: 所有的脂油，祭司都要烧在坛上，正如平安祭的脂油一样。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
4.en: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

4.zh: 「民中若有人行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，误犯了罪，
4.en: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

4.zh: 所犯的罪自己知道了，就要为所犯的罪牵一只没有残疾的母山羊为供物，
4.en: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

4.zh: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了。
4.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些羊的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，
4.en: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

4.zh: 又要把羊所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭牲的脂油一样。祭司要在坛上焚烧，在耶和华面前作为馨香[的祭]，为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
4.en: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

4.zh: 「人若牵一只绵羊羔为赎罪祭的供物，必要牵一只没有残疾的母羊，
4.en: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

4.zh: 按手在赎罪祭牲的头上，在那宰燔祭牲的地方宰了作赎罪祭。
4.en: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

4.zh: 祭司要用指头蘸些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在燔祭坛的四角上，所有的血都要倒在坛的脚那里，
4.en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

4.zh: 又要把所有的脂油都取下，正如取平安祭羊羔的脂油一样。祭司要按献给耶和华火祭的条例，烧在坛上。至于所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。」
4.en: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 「若有人听见发誓的声音，他本是见证，却不把所看见的、所知道的说出来，这就是罪；他要担当他的罪孽。
5.en: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

5.zh: 或是有人摸了不洁的物，无论是不洁的死兽，是不洁的死畜，是不洁的死虫，他却不知道，因此成了不洁，就有了罪。
5.en: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

5.zh: 或是他摸了别人的污秽，无论是染了什么污秽，他却不知道，一知道了就有了罪。
5.en: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

5.zh: 或是有人嘴里冒失发誓，要行恶，要行善，无论人在什么事上冒失发誓，他却不知道，一知道了就要在这其中的一件上有了罪。
5.en: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

5.zh: 他有了罪的时候，就要承认所犯的罪，
5.en: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

5.zh: 并要因所犯的罪，把他的赎愆祭牲—就是羊群中的母羊，或是一只羊羔，或是一只山羊—牵到耶和华面前为赎罪祭。至于他的罪，祭司要为他赎了。
5.en: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

5.zh: 「他的力量若不够献一只羊羔，就要因所犯的罪，把两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽带到耶和华面前为赎愆祭：一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
5.en: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

5.zh: 把这些带到祭司那里，祭司就要先把那赎罪祭献上，从鸟的颈项上揪下头来，只是不可把鸟撕断，
5.en: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

5.zh: 也把些赎罪祭牲的血弹在坛的旁边，剩下的血要流在坛的脚那里；这是赎罪祭。
5.en: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

5.zh: 他要照例献第二只为燔祭。至于他所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

5.zh: 「他的力量若不够献两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，就要因所犯的罪带供物来，就是细面伊法十分之一为赎罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因为是赎罪祭。
5.en: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

5.zh: 他要把供物带到祭司那里，祭司要取出自己的一把来作为纪念，按献给耶和华火祭的条例烧在坛上；这是赎罪祭。
5.en: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.

5.zh: 至于他在这几件事中所犯的罪，祭司要为他赎了，他必蒙赦免。[剩下的面]都归与祭司，和素祭一样。」
5.en: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”
The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

5.zh: 「人若在耶和华的圣物上误犯了罪，有了过犯，就要照你所估的，按圣所的舍客勒拿银子，将赎愆祭牲—就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊—牵到耶和华面前为赎愆祭；
5.en: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

5.zh: 并且他因在圣物上的差错要偿还，另外加五分之一，都给祭司。祭司要用赎愆祭的公绵羊为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 「若有人犯罪，行了耶和华所吩咐不可行的什么事，他虽然不知道，还是有了罪，就要担当他的罪孽；
5.en: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

5.zh: 也要照你所估定的价，从羊群中牵一只没有残疾的公绵羊来，给祭司作赎愆祭。至于他误行的那错事，祭司要为他赎罪，他必蒙赦免。
5.en: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

5.zh: 这是赎愆祭，因他在耶和华面前实在有了罪。」
5.en: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「若有人犯罪，干犯耶和华，在邻舍交付他的物上，或是在交易上行了诡诈，或是抢夺人的财物，或是欺压邻舍，
6.en: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

6.zh: 或是在捡了遗失的物上行了诡诈，说谎起誓，在这一切的事上犯了什么罪；
6.en: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

6.zh: 他既犯了罪，有了过犯，就要归还他所抢夺的，或是因欺压所得的，或是人交付他的，或是人遗失他所捡的物，
6.en: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

6.zh: 或是他因什么物起了假誓，就要如数归还，另外加上五分之一，在查出他有罪的日子要交还本主。
6.en: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

6.zh: 也要照你所估定的价，把赎愆祭牲—就是羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊—牵到耶和华面前，给祭司为赎愆祭。
6.en: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

6.zh: 祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪；他无论行了什么事，使他有了罪，都必蒙赦免。」
6.en: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「你要吩咐亚伦和他的子孙说，燔祭的条例乃是这样：燔祭要放在坛的柴上，从晚上到天亮，坛上的火要常常烧着。
6.en: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

6.zh: 祭司要穿上细麻布衣服，又要把细麻布裤子穿在身上，把坛上所烧的燔祭灰收起来，倒在坛的旁边；
6.en: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

6.zh: 随后要脱去这衣服，穿上别的衣服，把灰拿到营外洁净之处。
6.en: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

6.zh: 坛上的火要在其上常常烧着，不可熄灭。祭司要每日早晨在上面烧柴，并要把燔祭摆在坛上，在其上烧平安祭牲的脂油。
6.en: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

6.zh: 在坛上必有常常烧着的火，不可熄灭。」
6.en: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

6.zh: 「素祭的条例乃是这样：亚伦的子孙要在坛前把这祭献在耶和华面前。
6.en: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

6.zh: 祭司要从其中—就是从素祭的细面中—取出自己的一把，又要取些油和素祭上所有的乳香，烧在坛上，奉给耶和华为馨香素祭的纪念。
6.en: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.

6.zh: 所剩下的，亚伦和他子孙要吃，必在圣处不带酵而吃，要在会幕的院子里吃。
6.en: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

6.zh: [烤的时候]不可搀酵。这是从所献给我的火祭中赐给他们的分，是至圣的，和赎罪祭并赎愆祭一样。
6.en: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

6.zh: 凡献给耶和华的火祭，亚伦子孙中的男丁都要吃这一分，直到万代，作他们永得的分。摸这些祭物的，都要成为圣。」
6.en: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「当亚伦受膏的日子，他和他子孙所要献给耶和华的供物，就是细面伊法十分之一，为常献的素祭：早晨一半，晚上一半。
6.en: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

6.zh: 要在铁鏊上用油调和做成，调匀了，你就拿进来；烤好了分成块子，献给耶和华为馨香的素祭。
6.en: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

6.zh: 亚伦的子孙中，接续他为受膏的祭司，要把这素祭献上，要全烧给耶和华。这是永远的定例。
6.en: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.

6.zh: 祭司的素祭都要烧了，却不可吃。」
6.en: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

6.zh: 「你对亚伦和他的子孙说，赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在耶和华面前、宰燔祭牲的地方宰赎罪祭牲；这是至圣的。
6.en: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD. It is most holy.

6.zh: 为赎罪献这祭的祭司要吃，要在圣处，就是在会幕的院子里吃。
6.en: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

6.zh: 凡摸这祭肉的要成为圣；这祭牲的血若弹在什么衣服上，所弹的那一件要在圣处洗净。
6.en: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

6.zh: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在铜器里，这铜器要擦磨，在水中涮净。
6.en: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

6.zh: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃；这是至圣的。
6.en: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

6.zh: 凡赎罪祭，若将血带进会幕在圣所赎罪，那肉都不可吃，必用火焚烧。」
6.en: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

7.zh: 「赎愆祭的条例乃是如此：这祭是至圣的。
7.en: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

7.zh: 人在那里宰燔祭牲，也要在那里宰赎愆祭牲；其血，祭司要洒在坛的周围。
7.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

7.zh: 又要将肥尾巴和盖脏的脂油，
7.en: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

7.zh: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。
7.en: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

7.zh: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，为献给耶和华的火祭，是赎愆祭。
7.en: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

7.zh: 祭司中的男丁都可以吃这祭物；要在圣处吃，是至圣的。
7.en: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

7.zh: 赎罪祭怎样，赎愆祭也是怎样，两个祭是一个条例。献赎愆祭赎罪的祭司要得这祭物。
7.en: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

7.zh: 献燔祭的祭司，无论为谁奉献，要亲自得他所献那燔祭牲的皮。
7.en: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

7.zh: 凡在炉中烤的素祭和煎盘中做的，并铁鏊上做的，都要归那献祭的祭司。
7.en: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

7.zh: 凡素祭，无论是油调和的是干的，都要归亚伦的子孙，大家均分。」
7.en: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

7.zh: 「人献与耶和华平安祭的条例乃是这样：
7.en: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:

7.zh: 他若为感谢献上，就要用调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，并用油调匀细面做的饼，与感谢祭一同献上。
7.en: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

7.zh: 要用有酵的饼和为感谢献的平安祭，与供物一同献上。
7.en: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

7.zh: 从各样的供物中，他要把一个饼献给耶和华为举祭，是要归给洒平安祭牲血的祭司。
7.en: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

7.zh: 为感谢献平安祭牲的肉，要在献的日子吃，一点不可留到早晨。
7.en: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

7.zh: 若所献的是为还愿，或是甘心献的，必在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
7.en: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

7.zh: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
7.en: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

7.zh: 第三天若吃了平安祭的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反为可憎嫌的，吃这祭肉的，就必担当他的罪孽。
7.en: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

7.zh: 「挨了污秽物的肉就不可吃，要用火焚烧。至于平安祭的肉，凡洁净的人都要吃；
7.en: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

7.zh: 只是献与耶和华平安祭的肉，人若不洁净而吃了，这人必从民中剪除。
7.en: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

7.zh: 有人摸了什么不洁净的物，或是人的不洁净，或是不洁净的牲畜，或是不洁可憎之物，吃了献与耶和华平安祭的肉，这人必从民中剪除。」
7.en: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
7.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

7.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：牛的脂油、绵羊的脂油、山羊的脂油，你们都不可吃。
7.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

7.zh: 自死的和被野兽撕裂的，那脂油可以做别的使用，只是你们万不可吃。
7.en: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

7.zh: 无论何人吃了献给耶和华当火祭牲畜的脂油，那人必从民中剪除。
7.en: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

7.zh: 在你们一切的住处，无论是雀鸟的血是野兽的血，你们都不可吃。
7.en: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

7.zh: 无论是谁吃血，那人必从民中剪除。」
7.en: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
7.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

7.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：献平安祭给耶和华的，要从平安祭中取些来奉给耶和华。
7.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

7.zh: 他亲手献给耶和华的火祭，就是脂油和胸，要带来，好把胸在耶和华面前作摇祭，摇一摇。
7.en: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

7.zh: 祭司要把脂油在坛上焚烧，但胸要归亚伦和他的子孙。
7.en: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

7.zh: 你们要从平安祭中把右腿作举祭，奉给祭司。
7.en: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

7.zh: 亚伦子孙中，献平安祭牲血和脂油的，要得这右腿为分；
7.en: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

7.zh: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭中，取了这摇的胸和举的腿给祭司亚伦和他子孙，作他们从以色列人中所永得的分。」
7.en: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

7.zh: 这是从耶和华火祭中，作亚伦受膏的分和他子孙受膏的分，正在摩西叫他们前来给耶和华供祭司职分的日子，
7.en: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;

7.zh: 就是在摩西膏他们的日子，耶和华吩咐以色列人给他们的。这是他们世世代代永得的分。
7.en: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

7.zh: 这就是燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，和平安祭的条例，并承接圣职的礼，
7.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

7.zh: 都是耶和华在西奈山所吩咐摩西的，就是他在西奈旷野吩咐以色列人献供物给耶和华之日所说的。
7.en: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
8.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

8.zh: 「你将亚伦和他儿子一同带来，并将圣衣、膏油，与赎罪祭的一只公牛、两只公绵羊、一筐无酵饼都带来，
8.en: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

8.zh: 又招聚会众到会幕门口。」
8.en: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

8.zh: 摩西就照耶和华所吩咐的行了；于是会众聚集在会幕门口。
8.en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

8.zh: 摩西告诉会众说：「这就是耶和华所吩咐当行的事。」
8.en: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”

8.zh: 摩西带了亚伦和他儿子来，用水洗了他们。
8.en: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

8.zh: 给亚伦穿上内袍，束上腰带，穿上外袍，又加上以弗得，用其上巧工织的带子把以弗得系在他身上，
8.en: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

8.zh: 又给他戴上胸牌，把乌陵和土明放在胸牌内，
8.en: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

8.zh: 把冠冕戴在他头上，在冠冕的前面钉上金牌，就是圣冠，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 摩西用膏油抹帐幕和其中所有的，使它成圣；
8.en: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

8.zh: 又用膏油在坛上弹了七次，又抹了坛和坛的一切器皿，并洗濯盆和盆座，使它成圣；
8.en: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

8.zh: 又把膏油倒在亚伦的头上膏他，使他成圣。
8.en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

8.zh: 摩西带了亚伦的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍，束上腰带，包上裹头巾，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他牵了赎罪祭的公牛来，亚伦和他儿子按手在赎罪祭公牛的头上，
8.en: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

8.zh: 就宰了公牛。摩西用指头蘸血，抹在坛上四角的周围，使坛洁净，把血倒在坛的脚那里，使坛成圣，坛就洁净了；
8.en: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

8.zh: 又取脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，并两个腰子与腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上；
8.en: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

8.zh: 惟有公牛，连皮带肉并粪，用火烧在营外，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他奉上燔祭的公绵羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
8.en: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

8.zh: 就宰了公羊。摩西把血洒在坛的周围，
8.en: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

8.zh: 把羊切成块子，把头和肉块并脂油都烧了。
8.en: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

8.zh: 用水洗了脏腑和腿，就把全羊烧在坛上为馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 他又奉上第二只公绵羊，就是承接圣职之礼的羊；亚伦和他儿子按手在羊的头上，
8.en: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

8.zh: 就宰了羊。摩西把些血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，
8.en: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

8.zh: 又带了亚伦的儿子来，把些血抹在他们的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，又把血洒在坛的周围。
8.en: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

8.zh: 取脂油和肥尾巴，并脏上一切的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿，
8.en: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

8.zh: 再从耶和华面前、盛无酵饼的筐子里取出一个无酵饼，一个油饼，一个薄饼，都放在脂油和右腿上，
8.en: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

8.zh: 把这一切放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
8.en: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

8.zh: 摩西从他们的手上拿下来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，都是为承接圣职献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
8.en: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.

8.zh: 摩西拿羊的胸作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，是承接圣职之礼，归摩西的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
8.en: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.

8.zh: 摩西取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，使他和他们的衣服一同成圣。
8.en: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

8.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子说：「把肉煮在会幕门口，在那里吃，又吃承接圣职筐子里的饼，按我所吩咐的说：『这是亚伦和他儿子要吃的。』
8.en: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

8.zh: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。
8.en: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

8.zh: 你们七天不可出会幕的门，等到你们承接圣职的日子满了，因为主叫你们七天承接圣职。
8.en: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

8.zh: 像今天所行的都是耶和华吩咐行的，为你们赎罪。
8.en: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

8.zh: 七天你们要昼夜住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为所吩咐我的就是这样。」
8.en: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

8.zh: 于是亚伦和他儿子行了耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
8.en: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.

9.zh: 到了第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子，并以色列的众长老来，
9.en: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

9.zh: 对亚伦说：「你当取牛群中的一只公牛犊作赎罪祭，一只公绵羊作燔祭，都要没有残疾的，献在耶和华面前。
9.en: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

9.zh: 你也要对以色列人说：『你们当取一只公山羊作赎罪祭，又取一只牛犊和一只绵羊羔，都要一岁、没有残疾的，作燔祭，
9.en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

9.zh: 又取一只公牛，一只公绵羊作平安祭，献在耶和华面前，并取调油的素祭，因为今天耶和华要向你们显现。』」
9.en: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”

9.zh: 于是他们把摩西所吩咐的，带到会幕前；全会众都近前来，站在耶和华面前。
9.en: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

9.zh: 摩西说：「这是耶和华吩咐你们所当行的；耶和华的荣光就要向你们显现。」
9.en: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”

9.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：「你就近坛前，献你的赎罪祭和燔祭，为自己与百姓赎罪，又献上百姓的供物，为他们赎罪，都照耶和华所吩咐的。」
9.en: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”

9.zh: 于是，亚伦就近坛前，宰了为自己作赎罪祭的牛犊。
9.en: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

9.zh: 亚伦的儿子把血奉给他，他就把指头蘸在血中，抹在坛的四角上，又把血倒在坛脚那里。
9.en: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

9.zh: 惟有赎罪祭的脂油和腰子，并肝上取的网子，都烧在坛上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的；
9.en: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

9.zh: 又用火将肉和皮烧在营外。
9.en: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

9.zh: 亚伦宰了燔祭牲，他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围，
9.en: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

9.zh: 又把燔祭一块一块地、连头递给他，他都烧在坛上；
9.en: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

9.zh: 又洗了脏腑和腿，烧在坛上的燔祭上。
9.en: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

9.zh: 他奉上百姓的供物，把那给百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊宰了，为罪献上，和先献的一样；
9.en: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

9.zh: 也奉上燔祭，照例而献。
9.en: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

9.zh: 他又奉上素祭，从其中取一满把，烧在坛上；这是在早晨的燔祭以外。
9.en: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

9.zh: 亚伦宰了那给百姓作平安祭的公牛和公绵羊。他儿子把血递给他，他就洒在坛的周围；
9.en: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

9.zh: 又把公牛和公绵羊的脂油、肥尾巴，并盖[脏]的脂油与腰子，和肝上的网子，都递给他；
9.en: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

9.zh: 把脂油放在胸上，他就把脂油烧在坛上。
9.en: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

9.zh: 胸和右腿，亚伦当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
9.en: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

9.zh: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们祝福。他献了赎罪祭、燔祭、平安祭就下来了。
9.en: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

9.zh: 摩西、亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福，耶和华的荣光就向众民显现。
9.en: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.

9.zh: 有火从耶和华面前出来，在坛上烧尽燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，俯伏在地。
9.en: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

10.zh: 亚伦的儿子拿答、亚比户各拿自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上凡火，是耶和华没有吩咐他们的，
10.en: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.

10.zh: 就有火从耶和华面前出来，把他们烧灭，他们就死在耶和华面前。
10.en: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

10.zh: 于是摩西对亚伦说：「这就是耶和华所说：『我在亲近我的人中要显为圣；在众民面前，我要得荣耀。』」亚伦就默默不言。
10.en: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

10.zh: 摩西召了亚伦叔父乌薛的儿子米沙利、以利撒反来，对他们说：「上前来，把你们的亲属从圣所前抬到营外。」
10.en: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

10.zh: 于是二人上前来，把他们穿着袍子抬到营外，是照摩西所吩咐的。
10.en: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

10.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说：「不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣裳，免得你们死亡，又免得耶和华向会众发怒；只要你们的弟兄以色列全家为耶和华所发的火哀哭。
10.en: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.

10.zh: 你们也不可出会幕的门，恐怕你们死亡，因为耶和华的膏油在你们的身上。」他们就照摩西的话行了。
10.en: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

10.zh: 耶和华晓谕亚伦说：
10.en: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

10.zh: 「你和你儿子进会幕的时候，清酒、浓酒都不可喝，免得你们死亡；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
10.en: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

10.zh: 使你们可以将圣的、俗的，洁净的、不洁净的，分别出来；
10.en: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

10.zh: 又使你们可以将耶和华借摩西晓谕以色列人的一切律例教训他们。」
10.en: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”

10.zh: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说：「你们献给耶和华火祭中所剩的素祭，要在坛旁不带酵而吃，因为是至圣的。
10.en: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

10.zh: 你们要在圣处吃；因为在献给耶和华的火祭中，这是你的分和你儿子的分；所吩咐我的本是这样。
10.en: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.

10.zh: 所摇的胸，所举的腿，你们要在洁净地方吃。你和你的儿女都要同吃；因为这些是从以色列人平安祭中给你，当你的分和你儿子的分。
10.en: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

10.zh: 所举的腿，所摇的胸，他们要与火祭的脂油一同带来当摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这要归你和你儿子，当作永得的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐的。」
10.en: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”

10.zh: 当下摩西急切地寻找作赎罪祭的公山羊，谁知已经焚烧了，便向亚伦剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛发怒，说：
10.en: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

10.zh: 「这赎罪祭既是至圣的，主又给了你们，为要你们担当会众的罪孽，在耶和华面前为他们赎罪，你们为何没有在圣所吃呢？
10.en: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

10.zh: 看哪，这祭牲的血并没有拿到圣所里去，你们本当照我所吩咐的，在圣所里吃这祭肉。」
10.en: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

10.zh: 亚伦对摩西说：「今天他们在耶和华面前献上赎罪祭和燔祭，我又遇见这样的灾，若今天吃了赎罪祭，耶和华岂能看为美呢？」
10.en: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”

10.zh: 摩西听见[这话]，便以为美。
10.en: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
11.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

11.zh: 「你们晓谕以色列人说，在地上一切走兽中可吃的乃是这些：
11.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

11.zh: 凡蹄分两瓣、倒嚼的走兽，你们都可以吃。
11.en: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

11.zh: 但那倒嚼或分蹄之中不可吃的乃是：骆驼—因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

11.zh: 沙番—因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

11.zh: 兔子—因为倒嚼不分蹄，就与你们不洁净；
11.en: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

11.zh: 猪—因为蹄分两瓣，却不倒嚼，就与你们不洁净。
11.en: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

11.zh: 这些兽的肉，你们不可吃；死的，你们不可摸，都与你们不洁净。
11.en: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

11.zh: 「水中可吃的乃是这些：凡在水里、海里、河里、有翅有鳞的，都可以吃。
11.en: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

11.zh: 凡在海里、河里，并一切水里游动的活物，无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

11.zh: 这些无翅无鳞、以为可憎的，你们不可吃它的肉；死的也当以为可憎。
11.en: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

11.zh: 凡水里无翅无鳞的，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

11.zh: 「雀鸟中你们当以为可憎、不可吃的乃是：雕、狗头雕、红头雕、
11.en: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

11.zh: 鹞鹰、小鹰与其类；
11.en: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

11.zh: 乌鸦与其类；
11.en: any kind of raven,

11.zh: 鸵鸟、夜鹰、鱼鹰、鹰与其类；
11.en: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

11.zh: 鸮鸟、鸬鹚、猫头鹰、
11.en: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

11.zh: 角鸱、鹈鹕、秃雕、
11.en: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

11.zh: 鹳、鹭鸶与其类；戴 与蝙蝠。
11.en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

11.zh: 「凡有翅膀用四足爬行的物，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

11.zh: 只是有翅膀用四足爬行的物中，有足有腿，在地上蹦跳的，你们还可以吃。
11.en: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

11.zh: 其中有蝗虫、蚂蚱、蟋蟀与其类；蚱蜢与其类；这些你们都可以吃。
11.en: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

11.zh: 但是有翅膀有四足的爬物，你们都当以为可憎。
11.en: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

11.zh: 「这些都能使你们不洁净。凡摸了死的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 凡拿了死的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
11.en: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 凡走兽分蹄不成两瓣、也不倒嚼的，是与你们不洁净；凡摸了的就不洁净。
11.en: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

11.zh: 凡四足的走兽，用掌行走的，是与你们不洁净；摸其尸的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 拿其尸的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。这些是与你们不洁净的。
11.en: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

11.zh: 「地上爬物与你们不洁净的乃是这些：鼬鼠、鼫鼠、蜥蜴与其类；
11.en: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

11.zh: 壁虎、龙子、守宫、蛇医、蝘蜓。
11.en: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

11.zh: 这些爬物都是与你们不洁净的。在它死了以后，凡摸了的，必不洁净到晚上。
11.en: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 其中死了的，掉在什么东西上，这东西就不洁净，无论是木器、衣服、皮子、口袋，不拘是做什么工用的器皿，须要放在水中，必不洁净到晚上，到晚上才洁净了。
11.en: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

11.zh: 若有死了掉在瓦器里的，其中不拘有什么，就不洁净，你们要把这瓦器打破了。
11.en: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

11.zh: 其中一切可吃的食物，沾水的就不洁净，并且那样器皿中一切可喝的，也必不洁净。
11.en: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

11.zh: 其中已死的，若有一点掉在什么物件上，那物件就不洁净，不拘是炉子，是锅台，就要打碎，都不洁净，也必与你们不洁净。
11.en: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

11.zh: 但是泉源或是聚水的池子仍是洁净；惟挨了那死的，就不洁净。
11.en: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

11.zh: 若是死的，有一点掉在要种的子粒上，子粒仍是洁净；
11.en: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

11.zh: 若水已经浇在子粒上，那死的有一点掉在上头，这子粒就与你们不洁净。
11.en: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

11.zh: 「你们可吃的走兽若是死了，有人摸它，必不洁净到晚上；
11.en: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 有人吃那死了的走兽，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服；拿了死走兽的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服。
11.en: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

11.zh: 「凡地上的爬物是可憎的，都不可吃。
11.en: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

11.zh: 凡用肚子行走的和用四足行走的，或是有许多足的，就是一切爬在地上的，你们都不可吃，因为是可憎的。
11.en: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

11.zh: 你们不可因什么爬物使自己成为可憎的，也不可因这些使自己不洁净，以致染了污秽。
11.en: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

11.zh: 我是耶和华—你们的　神；所以你们要成为圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。你们也不可在地上的爬物污秽自己。
11.en: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

11.zh: 我是把你们从埃及地领出来的耶和华，要作你们的　神；所以你们要圣洁，因为我是圣洁的。」
11.en: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

11.zh: 这是走兽、飞鸟，和水中游动的活物，并地上爬物的条例。
11.en: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

11.zh: 要把洁净的和不洁净的，可吃的与不可吃的活物，都分别出来。
11.en: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

12.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

12.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：若有妇人怀孕生男孩，她就不洁净七天，像在月经污秽的日子不洁净一样。
12.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

12.zh: 第八天，要给婴孩行割礼。
12.en: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

12.zh: 妇人在产血不洁之中，要家居三十三天。她洁净的日子未满，不可摸圣物，也不可进入圣所。
12.en: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

12.zh: 她若生女孩，就不洁净两个七天，像污秽[的时候]一样，要在产血不洁之中，家居六十六天。
12.en: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

12.zh: 「满了洁净的日子，无论是为男孩是为女孩，她要把一岁的羊羔为燔祭，一只雏鸽或是一只斑鸠为赎罪祭，带到会幕门口交给祭司。
12.en: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

12.zh: 祭司要献在耶和华面前，为她赎罪，她的血源就洁净了。这条例是为生育的妇人，无论是生男生女。
12.en: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

12.zh: 她的力量若不够献一只羊羔，她就要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，一只为燔祭，一只为赎罪祭。祭司要为她赎罪，她就洁净了。」
12.en: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

13.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
13.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

13.zh: 「人的肉皮上若长了疖子，或长了癣，或长了火斑，在他肉皮上成了大麻风的灾病，就要将他带到祭司亚伦或亚伦作祭司的一个子孙面前。
13.en: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

13.zh: 祭司要察看肉皮上的灾病，若灾病处的毛已经变白，灾病的现象深于肉上的皮，这便是大麻风的灾病。祭司要察看他，定他为不洁净。
13.en: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

13.zh: 若火斑在他肉皮上是白的，现象不深于皮，其上的毛也没有变白，祭司就要将有灾病的人关锁七天。
13.en: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看他，若看灾病止住了，没有在皮上发散，祭司还要将他关锁七天。
13.en: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要再察看他，若灾病发暗，而且没有在皮上发散，祭司要定他为洁净，原来是癣；那人就要洗衣服，得为洁净。
13.en: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

13.zh: 但他为得洁净，将身体给祭司察看以后，癣若在皮上发散开了，他要再将身体给祭司察看。
13.en: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，癣若在皮上发散，就要定他为不洁净，是大麻风。
13.en: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

13.zh: 「人有了大麻风的灾病，就要将他带到祭司面前。
13.en: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

13.zh: 祭司要察看，皮上若长了白疖，使毛变白，在长白疖之处有了红瘀肉，
13.en: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

13.zh: 这是肉皮上的旧大麻风，祭司要定他为不洁净，不用将他关锁，因为他是不洁净了。
13.en: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

13.zh: 大麻风若在皮上四外发散，长满了患灾病人的皮，据祭司察看，从头到脚无处不有，
13.en: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，全身的肉若长满了大麻风，就要定那患灾病的为洁净；全身都变为白，他乃洁净了。
13.en: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

13.zh: 但红肉几时显在他的身上就几时不洁净。
13.en: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

13.zh: 祭司一看那红肉就定他为不洁净。红肉本是不洁净，是大麻风。
13.en: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

13.zh: 红肉若复原，又变白了，他就要来见祭司。
13.en: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，灾病处若变白了，祭司就要定那患灾病的为洁净，他乃洁净了。
13.en: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

13.zh: 「人若在皮肉上长疮，却治好了，
13.en: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

13.zh: 在长疮之处又起了白疖，或是白中带红的火斑，就要给祭司察看。
13.en: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司要察看，若现象洼于皮，其上的毛也变白了，就要定他为不洁净，是大麻风的灾病发在疮中。
13.en: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

13.zh: 祭司若察看，其上没有白毛，也没有洼于皮，乃是发暗，就要将他关锁七天。
13.en: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

13.zh: 若在皮上发散开了，祭司就要定他为不洁净，是灾病。
13.en: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

13.zh: 火斑若在原处止住，没有发散，便是疮的痕迹，祭司就要定他为洁净。
13.en: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

13.zh: 「人的皮肉上若起了火毒，火毒的瘀[肉]成了火斑，或是白中带红的，或是全白的，
13.en: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，火斑中的毛若变白了，现象又深于皮，是大麻风在火毒中发出，就要定他为不洁净，是大麻风的灾病。
13.en: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

13.zh: 但是祭司察看，在火斑中若没有白毛，也没有洼于皮，乃是发暗，就要将他关锁七天。
13.en: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

13.zh: 到第七天，祭司要察看他，火斑若在皮上发散开了，就要定他为不洁净，是大麻风的灾病。
13.en: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

13.zh: 火斑若在原处止住，没有在皮上发散，乃是发暗，是起的火毒，祭司要定他为洁净，不过是火毒的痕迹。
13.en: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

13.zh: 「无论男女，若在头上有灾病，或是男人胡须上有灾病，
13.en: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看；这灾病现象若深于皮，其间有细黄毛，就要定他为不洁净，这是头疥，是头上或是胡须上的大麻风。
13.en: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

13.zh: 祭司若察看头疥的灾病，现象不深于皮，其间也没有黑毛，就要将长头疥灾病的关锁七天。
13.en: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看灾病，若头疥没有发散，其间也没有黄毛，头疥的现象不深于皮，
13.en: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

13.zh: 那人就要剃去须发，但他不可剃头疥之处。祭司要将那长头疥的，再关锁七天。
13.en: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

13.zh: 第七天，祭司要察看头疥，头疥若没有在皮上发散，现象也不深于皮，就要定他为洁净，他要洗衣服，便成为洁净。
13.en: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

13.zh: 但他得洁净以后，头疥若在皮上发散开了，
13.en: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看他。头疥若在皮上发散，就不必找那黄毛，他是不洁净了。
13.en: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

13.zh: 祭司若看头疥已经止住，其间也长了黑毛，头疥已然痊愈，那人是洁净了，就要定他为洁净。
13.en: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

13.zh: 「无论男女，皮肉上若起了火斑，就是白火斑，
13.en: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，他们肉皮上的火斑若白中带黑，这是皮上发出的白癣，那人是洁净了。
13.en: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

13.zh: 「人头上的发若掉了，他不过是头秃，还是洁净。
13.en: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

13.zh: 他顶前若掉了头发，他不过是顶门秃，还是洁净。
13.en: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

13.zh: 头秃处或是顶门秃处若有白中带红的灾病，这就是大麻风发在他头秃处或是顶门秃处，
13.en: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

13.zh: 祭司就要察看，他起的那灾病若在头秃处或是顶门秃处有白中带红的，像肉皮上大麻风的现象，
13.en: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

13.zh: 那人就是长大麻风，不洁净的，祭司总要定他为不洁净，他的灾病是在头上。
13.en: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

13.zh: 「身上有长大麻风灾病的，他的衣服要撕裂，也要蓬头散发，蒙着上唇，喊叫说：『不洁净了！不洁净了！』
13.en: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

13.zh: 灾病在他身上的日子，他便是不洁净；他既是不洁净，就要独居营外。」
13.en: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

13.zh: 「染了大麻风灾病的衣服，无论是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
13.en: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

13.zh: 无论是在经上、在纬上，是麻布的、是羊毛的，是在皮子上，或在皮子做的什么物件上，
13.en: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

13.zh: 或在衣服上、皮子上，经上、纬上，或在皮子做的什么物件上，这灾病若是发绿，或是发红，是大麻风的灾病，要给祭司察看。
13.en: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

13.zh: 祭司就要察看那灾病，把染了灾病的物件关锁七天。
13.en: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

13.zh: 第七天，他要察看那灾病，灾病或在衣服上，经上、纬上，皮子上，若发散，这皮子无论当作何用，这灾病是蚕食的大麻风，都是不洁净了。
13.en: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

13.zh: 那染了灾病的衣服，或是经上、纬上，羊毛上，麻衣上，或是皮子做的什么物件上，他都要焚烧；因为这是蚕食的大麻风，必在火中焚烧。
13.en: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

13.zh: 「祭司要察看，若灾病在衣服上，经上、纬上，或是皮子做的什么物件上，没有发散，
13.en: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

13.zh: 祭司就要吩咐他们，把染了灾病的物件洗了，再关锁七天。
13.en: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

13.zh: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，那物件若没有变色，灾病也没有消散，那物件就不洁净，是透重的灾病，无论正面反面，都要在火中焚烧。
13.en: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

13.zh: 洗过以后，祭司要察看，若见那灾病发暗，他就要把那灾病从衣服上，皮子上，经上、纬上，都撕去。
13.en: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

13.zh: 若仍现在衣服上，或是经上、纬上、皮子做的什么物件上，这就是灾病又发了，必用火焚烧那染灾病的物件。
13.en: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

13.zh: 所洗的衣服，或是经，或是纬，或是皮子做的什么物件，若灾病离开了，要再洗，就洁净了。」
13.en: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

13.zh: 这就是大麻风灾病的条例，无论是在羊毛衣服上，麻布衣服上，经上、纬上，和皮子做的什么物件上，可以定为洁净或是不洁净。
13.en: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

14.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：「
14.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

14.zh: 长大麻风得洁净的日子，其例乃是这样：要带他去见祭司；
14.en: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

14.zh: 祭司要出到营外察看，若见他的大麻风痊愈了，
14.en: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

14.zh: 就要吩咐人为那求洁净的拿两只洁净的活鸟和香柏木、朱红色[线]，并牛膝草来。
14.en: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

14.zh: 祭司要吩咐用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面。
14.en: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

14.zh: 至于那只活鸟，祭司要把它和香柏木、朱红色[线]并牛膝草一同蘸于宰在活水上的鸟血中，
14.en: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

14.zh: 用以在那长大麻风求洁净的人身上洒七次，就定他为洁净，又把活鸟放在田野里。
14.en: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

14.zh: 求洁净的人当洗衣服，剃去毛发，用水洗澡，就洁净了；然后可以进营，只是要在自己的帐棚外居住七天。
14.en: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

14.zh: 第七天，再把头上所有的头发与胡须、眉毛，并全身的毛，都剃了；又要洗衣服，用水洗身，就洁净了。
14.en: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

14.zh: 「第八天，他要取两只没有残疾的公羊羔和一只没有残疾、一岁的母羊羔，又要把调油的细面[伊法]十分之三为素祭，并油一罗革，一同取来。
14.en: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

14.zh: 行洁净之礼的祭司要将那求洁净的人和这些东西安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前。
14.en: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

14.zh: 祭司要取一只公羊羔献为赎愆祭，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；
14.en: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

14.zh: 把公羊羔宰于圣地，就是宰赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地。赎愆祭要归祭司，与赎罪祭一样，是至圣的。
14.en: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

14.zh: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
14.en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

14.zh: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，
14.en: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

14.zh: 把右手的一个指头蘸在左手的油里，在耶和华面前用指头弹七次。
14.en: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

14.zh: 将手里所剩的油抹在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲的血上。
14.en: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

14.zh: 祭司手里所剩的油要抹在那求洁净人的头上，在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.

14.zh: 祭司要献赎罪祭，为那本不洁净、求洁净的人赎罪；然后要宰燔祭牲，
14.en: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

14.zh: 把燔祭和素祭献在坛上，为他赎罪，他就洁净了。
14.en: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

14.zh: 「他若贫穷不能预备够数，就要取一只公羊羔作赎愆祭，可以摇一摇，为他赎罪；也要把调油的细面[伊法]十分之一为素祭，和油一罗革一同取来；
14.en: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

14.zh: 又照他的力量取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，一只作赎罪祭，一只作燔祭。
14.en: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

14.zh: 第八天，要为洁净，把这些带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司。
14.en: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

14.zh: 祭司要把赎愆祭的羊羔和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
14.en: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

14.zh: 要宰了赎愆祭的羊羔，取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
14.en: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

14.zh: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌里，
14.en: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

14.zh: 把左手里的油，在耶和华面前，用右手的一个指头弹七次，
14.en: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.

14.zh: 又把手里的油抹些在那求洁净人的右耳垂上和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹赎愆祭之血的原处。
14.en: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

14.zh: 祭司手里所剩的油要抹在那求洁净人的头上，在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

14.zh: 那人又要照他的力量献上一只斑鸠或是一只雏鸽，
14.en: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

14.zh: 就是他所能办的，一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭，与素祭一同献上；祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
14.en: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”

14.zh: 这是那有大麻风灾病的人、不能将[关乎]得洁净之物预备够数的条例。」
14.en: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

14.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西、亚伦说：
14.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

14.zh: 「你们到了我赐给你们为业的迦南地，我若使你们所得为业之地的房屋中有大麻风的灾病，
14.en: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

14.zh: 房主就要去告诉祭司说：『据我看，房屋中似乎有灾病。』
14.en: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

14.zh: 祭司还没有进去察看灾病以前，就要吩咐人把房子腾空，免得房子里所有的都成了不洁净；然后祭司要进去察看房子。
14.en: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

14.zh: 他要察看那灾病，灾病若在房子的墙上有发绿或发红的凹斑纹，现象洼于墙，
14.en: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

14.zh: 祭司就要出到房门外，把房子封锁七天。
14.en: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

14.zh: 第七天，祭司要再去察看，灾病若在房子的墙上发散，
14.en: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

14.zh: 就要吩咐人把那有灾病的石头挖出来，扔在城外不洁净之处；
14.en: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

14.zh: 也要叫人刮房内的四围，所刮掉的灰泥要倒在城外不洁净之处；
14.en: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

14.zh: 又要用别的石头代替那挖出来的石头，要另用灰泥墁房子。
14.en: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

14.zh: 「他挖出石头，刮了房子，墁了以后，灾病若在房子里又发现，
14.en: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

14.zh: 祭司就要进去察看，灾病若在房子里发散，这就是房内蚕食的大麻风，是不洁净。
14.en: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

14.zh: 他就要拆毁房子，把石头、木头、灰泥都搬到城外不洁净之处。
14.en: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

14.zh: 在房子封锁的时候，进去的人必不洁净到晚上；
14.en: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

14.zh: 在房子里躺着的必洗衣服；在房子里吃饭的也必洗衣服。
14.en: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

14.zh: 「房子墁了以后，祭司若进去察看，见灾病在房内没有发散，就要定房子为洁净，因为灾病已经消除。
