14.en: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

14.zh: 要为洁净房子取两只鸟和香柏木、朱红色[线]并牛膝草，
14.en: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

14.zh: 用瓦器盛活水，把一只鸟宰在上面，
14.en: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

14.zh: 把香柏木、牛膝草、朱红色[线]，并那活鸟，都蘸在被宰的鸟血中与活水中，用以洒房子七次。
14.en: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

14.zh: 要用鸟血、活水、活鸟、香柏木、牛膝草，并朱红色[线]，洁净那房子。
14.en: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

14.zh: 但要把活鸟放在城外田野里。这样洁净房子，房子就洁净了。」
14.en: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

14.zh: 这是为各类大麻风的灾病和头疥，
14.en: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

14.zh: 并衣服与房子的大麻风，
14.en: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

14.zh: 以及疖子、癣、火斑所立的条例，
14.en: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

14.zh: 指明何时为洁净，何时为不洁净。这是大麻风的条例。
14.en: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

15.zh: 耶和华对摩西、亚伦说：
15.en: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

15.zh: 「你们晓谕以色列人说：人若身患漏症，他因这漏症就不洁净了。
15.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

15.zh: 他患漏症，无论是下流的，是止住的，都是不洁净。
15.en: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

15.zh: 他所躺的床都为不洁净，所坐的物也为不洁净。
15.en: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

15.zh: 凡摸那床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 那坐患漏症人所坐之物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 那摸患漏症人身体的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 若患漏症人吐在洁净的人身上，那人必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 患漏症人所骑的鞍子也为不洁净。
15.en: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

15.zh: 凡摸了他身下之物的，必不洁净到晚上；拿了那物的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 患漏症的人没有用水涮手，无论摸了谁，谁必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 患漏症人所摸的瓦器就必打破；所摸的一切木器也必用水涮洗。
15.en: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

15.zh: 「患漏症的人痊愈了，就要为洁净自己计算七天，也必洗衣服，用活水洗身，就洁净了。
15.en: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

15.zh: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，来到会幕门口、耶和华面前，把鸟交给祭司。
15.en: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

15.zh: 祭司要献上一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人患的漏症，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪。
15.en: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.

15.zh: 「人若[梦]遗，他必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗全身。
15.en: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 无论是衣服是皮子，被精所染，必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗。
15.en: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 若男女交合，两个人必不洁净到晚上，并要用水洗澡。
15.en: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 「女人行经，必污秽七天；凡摸她的，必不洁净到晚上。
15.en: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 女人在污秽之中，凡她所躺的物件都为不洁净，所坐的物件也都不洁净。
15.en: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

15.zh: 凡摸她床的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 凡摸她所坐什么物件的，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 在女人的床上，或在她坐的物上，若有别的物件，人一摸了，必不洁净到晚上。
15.en: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 男人若与那女人同房，染了她的污秽，就要七天不洁净；所躺的床也为不洁净。
15.en: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

15.zh: 「女人若在经期以外患多日的血漏，或是经期过长，有了漏症，她就因这漏症不洁净，与她在经期不洁净一样。
15.en: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

15.zh: 她在患漏症的日子所躺的床、所坐的物都要看为不洁净，与她月经的时候一样。
15.en: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

15.zh: 凡摸这些物件的，就为不洁净，必不洁净到晚上，并要洗衣服，用水洗澡。
15.en: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

15.zh: 女人的漏症若好了，就要计算七天，然后才为洁净。
15.en: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

15.zh: 第八天，要取两只斑鸠或是两只雏鸽，带到会幕门口给祭司。
15.en: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

15.zh: 祭司要献一只为赎罪祭，一只为燔祭；因那人血漏不洁，祭司要在耶和华面前为她赎罪。
15.en: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.

15.zh: 「你们要这样使以色列人与他们的污秽隔绝，免得他们玷污我的帐幕，就因自己的污秽死亡。」
15.en: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

15.zh: 这是患漏症和[梦]遗而不洁净的，
15.en: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

15.zh: 并有月经病的和患漏症的，无论男女，并人与不洁净女人同房的条例。
15.en: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

16.zh: 亚伦的两个儿子近到耶和华面前死了。死了之后，耶和华晓谕摩西说：
16.en: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;

16.zh: 「要告诉你哥哥亚伦，不可随时进圣所的幔子内、到柜上的施恩座前，免得他死亡，因为我要从云中显现在施恩座上。
16.en: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

16.zh: 亚伦进圣所，要带一只公牛犊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
16.en: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

16.zh: 要穿上细麻布圣内袍，把细麻布裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布带子，头戴细麻布冠冕；这都是圣服。他要用水洗身，然后穿戴。
16.en: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

16.zh: 要从以色列会众取两只公山羊为赎罪祭，一只公绵羊为燔祭。
16.en: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

16.zh: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛奉上，为自己和本家赎罪；
16.en: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

16.zh: 也要把两只公山羊安置在会幕门口、耶和华面前，
16.en: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

16.zh: 为那两只羊拈阄，一阄归与耶和华，一阄归与阿撒泻勒。
16.en: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

16.zh: 亚伦要把那拈阄归与耶和华的羊献为赎罪祭，
16.en: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.

16.zh: 但那拈阄归与阿撒泻勒的羊要活着安置在耶和华面前，用以赎罪，打发[人送]到旷野去，归与阿撒泻勒。
16.en: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

16.zh: 「亚伦要把赎罪祭的公牛牵来宰了，为自己和本家赎罪；
16.en: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

16.zh: 拿香炉，从耶和华面前的坛上盛满火炭，又拿一捧捣细的香料，都带入幔子内，
16.en: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

16.zh: 在耶和华面前，把香放在火上，使香的烟云遮掩法[柜]上的施恩座，免得他死亡；
16.en: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

16.zh: 也要取些公牛的血，用指头弹在施恩座的东面，又在施恩座的前面弹血七次。
16.en: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

16.zh: 「随后他要宰那为百姓作赎罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血带入幔子内，弹在施恩座的上面和前面，好像弹公牛的血一样。
16.en: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

16.zh: 他因以色列人诸般的污秽、过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，当这样在圣所行赎罪之礼，并因会幕在他们污秽之中，也要照样而行。
16.en: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

16.zh: 他进圣所赎罪的时候，会幕里不可有人，直等到他为自己和本家并以色列全会众赎了罪出来。
16.en: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

16.zh: 他出来，要到耶和华面前的坛那里，在坛上行赎罪之礼，又要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在坛上四角的周围；
16.en: “He shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

16.zh: 也要用指头把血弹在坛上七次，洁净了坛，从坛上除掉以色列人诸般的污秽，使坛成圣。」
16.en: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

16.zh: 「亚伦为圣所和会幕并坛献完了赎罪祭，就要把那只活着的公山羊奉上。
16.en: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

16.zh: 两手按在羊头上，承认以色列人诸般的罪孽过犯，就是他们一切的罪愆，把这罪都归在羊的头上，借着所派之人的手，送到旷野去。
16.en: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

16.zh: 要把这羊放在旷野，这羊要担当他们一切的罪孽，带到无人之地。
16.en: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

16.zh: 「亚伦要进会幕，把他进圣所时所穿的细麻布衣服脱下，放在那里，
16.en: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

16.zh: 又要在圣处用水洗身，穿上衣服，出来，把自己的燔祭和百姓的燔祭献上，为自己和百姓赎罪。
16.en: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

16.zh: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要在坛上焚烧。
16.en: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

16.zh: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
16.en: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

16.zh: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入圣所赎罪，这牛羊就要搬到营外，将皮、肉、粪用火焚烧。
16.en: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

16.zh: 焚烧的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。」
16.en: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

16.zh: 「每逢七月初十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，什么工都不可做；这要作你们永远的定例。
16.en: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

16.zh: 因在这日要为你们赎罪，使你们洁净。你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪愆。
16.en: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

16.zh: 这日你们要守为圣安息日，要刻苦己心；这为永远的定例。
16.en: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

16.zh: 那受膏、接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司要穿上细麻布的圣衣，行赎罪之礼。
16.en: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

16.zh: 他要在至圣所和会幕与坛行赎罪之礼，并要为众祭司和会众的百姓赎罪。
16.en: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

16.zh: 这要作你们永远的定例—就是因以色列人一切的罪，要一年一次为他们赎罪。」 于是，亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
16.en: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as the LORD commanded Moses.

17.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

17.zh: 「你晓谕亚伦和他儿子并以色列众人说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
17.en: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:

17.zh: 凡以色列家中的人宰公牛，或是绵羊羔，或是山羊，不拘宰于营内营外，
17.en: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

17.zh: 若未曾牵到会幕门口、耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必归到那人身上。他流了血，要从民中剪除。
17.en: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.

17.zh: 这是为要使以色列人把他们在田野里所献的祭带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司，献与耶和华为平安祭。
17.en: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.

17.zh: 祭司要把血洒在会幕门口、耶和华的坛上，把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为馨香的祭。
17.en: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

17.zh: 他们不可再献祭给他们行邪淫所随从的鬼魔；这要作他们世世代代永远的定例。
17.en: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

17.zh: 「你要晓谕他们说：凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，献燔祭或是[平安]祭，
17.en: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

17.zh: 若不带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
17.en: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.

17.zh: 「凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若吃什么血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
17.en: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

17.zh: 因为活物的生命是在血中。我把这血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命赎罪；因血里有生命，所以能赎罪。
17.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

17.zh: 因此，我对以色列人说：你们都不可吃血；寄居在你们中间的外人也不可吃血。
17.en: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

17.zh: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若打猎得了可吃的禽兽，必放出它的血来，用土掩盖。
17.en: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

17.zh: 「论到一切活物的生命，就在血中。所以我对以色列人说：无论什么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的血就是他的生命。凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
17.en: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

17.zh: 凡吃自死的，或是被野兽撕裂的，无论是本地人，是寄居的，必不洁净到晚上，都要洗衣服，用水洗身，到了晚上才为洁净。
17.en: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

17.zh: 但他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必担当他的罪孽。」
17.en: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

18.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
18.en: The LORD said to Moses,

18.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：我是耶和华—你们的　神。
18.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

18.zh: 你们从前住的埃及地，那里人的行为，你们不可效法，我要领你们到的迦南地，那里人的行为也不可效法，也不可照他们的恶俗行。
18.en: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

18.zh: 你们要遵我的典章，守我的律例，按此而行。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
18.en: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.

18.zh: 所以，你们要守我的律例典章；人若遵行，就必因此活着。我是耶和华。
18.en: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.

18.zh: 「你们都不可露骨肉之亲的下体，亲近他们。我是耶和华。
18.en: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

18.zh: 不可露你母亲的下体，羞辱了你父亲。她是你的母亲，不可露她的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

18.zh: 不可露你继母的下体；这本是你父亲的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

18.zh: 你的姊妹，不拘是异母同父的，是异父同母的，无论是生在家生在外的，都不可露她们的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

18.zh: 不可露你孙女或是外孙女的下体，露了她们的下体就是露了自己的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

18.zh: 你继母从你父亲生的女儿本是你的妹妹，不可露她的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

18.zh: 不可露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

18.zh: 不可露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

18.zh: 不可亲近你伯叔之妻，羞辱了你伯叔；她是你的伯叔母。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

18.zh: 不可露你儿妇的下体；她是你儿子的妻，不可露她的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

18.zh: 不可露你弟兄妻子的下体；这本是你弟兄的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

18.zh: 不可露了妇人的下体，又露她女儿的下体，也不可娶她孙女或是外孙女，露她们的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这本是大恶。
18.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

18.zh: 你妻还在的时候，不可另娶她的姊妹作对头，露她的下体。
18.en: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

18.zh: 「女人行经不洁净的时候，不可露她的下体，与她亲近。
18.en: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

18.zh: 不可与邻舍的妻行淫，玷污自己。
18.en: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

18.zh: 不可使你的儿女经火归与摩洛，也不可亵渎你　神的名。我是耶和华。
18.en: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

18.zh: 不可与男人苟合，像与女人一样；这本是可憎恶的。
18.en: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

18.zh: 不可与兽淫合，玷污自己。女人也不可站在兽前，与它淫合；这本是逆性的事。
18.en: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

18.zh: 「在这一切的事上，你们都不可玷污自己；因为我在你们面前所逐出的列邦，在这一切的事上玷污了自己；
18.en: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

18.zh: 连地也玷污了，所以我追讨那地的罪孽，那地也吐出它的居民。
18.en: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

18.zh: 故此，你们要守我的律例典章。这一切可憎恶的事，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，都不可行，（
18.en: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

18.zh: 在你们以先居住那地的人行了这一切可憎恶的事，地就玷污了，）
18.en: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

18.zh: 免得你们玷污那地的时候，地就把你们吐出，像吐出在你们以先的国民一样。
18.en: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

18.zh: 无论什么人，行了其中可憎的一件事，必从民中剪除。
18.en: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

18.zh: 所以，你们要守我所吩咐的，免得你们随从那些可憎的恶俗，就是在你们以先[的人]所常行的，以致玷污了自己。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
18.en: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”

19.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
19.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

19.zh: 「你晓谕以色列全会众说：你们要圣洁，因为我耶和华—你们的　神是圣洁的。
19.en: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.

19.zh: 你们各人都当孝敬父母，也要守我的安息日。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 你们不可偏向虚无的神，也不可为自己铸造神[像]。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 你们献平安祭给耶和华的时候，要献得可蒙悦纳。
19.en: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

19.zh: 这祭物要在献的那一天和第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就必用火焚烧。
19.en: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

19.zh: 第三天若再吃，这就为可憎恶的，必不蒙悦纳。
19.en: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

19.zh: 凡吃的人必担当他的罪孽；因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物，那人必从民中剪除。
19.en: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

19.zh: 「在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的。
19.en: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

19.zh: 不可摘尽葡萄园的果子，也不可拾取葡萄园所掉的果子；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 「你们不可偷盗，不可欺骗，也不可彼此说谎。
19.en: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

19.zh: 不可指着我的名起假誓，亵渎你　神的名。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「不可欺压你的邻舍，也不可抢夺他的物。雇工人的工价，不可在你那里过夜，留到早晨。
19.en: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

19.zh: 不可咒骂聋子，也不可将绊脚石放在瞎子面前，只要敬畏你的　神。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「你们施行审判，不可行不义；不可偏护穷人，也不可重看有势力的人，只要按着公义审判你的邻舍。
19.en: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

19.zh: 不可在民中往来搬弄是非，也不可与邻舍为敌，置之于死。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「不可心里恨你的弟兄；总要指摘你的邻舍，免得因他担罪。
19.en: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

19.zh: 不可报仇，也不可埋怨你本国的子民，却要爱人如己。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「你们要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜与异类配合；不可用两样搀杂的种种你的地，也不可用两样搀杂的料做衣服穿在身上。
19.en: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

19.zh: 「婢女许配了丈夫，还没有被赎、得释放，人若与她行淫，二人要受刑罚，却不把他们治死，因为婢女还没有得自由。
19.en: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

19.zh: 那人要把赎愆祭，就是一只公绵羊牵到会幕门口、耶和华面前。
19.en: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

19.zh: 祭司要用赎愆祭的羊在耶和华面前赎他所犯的罪，他的罪就必蒙赦免。
19.en: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

19.zh: 「你们到了迦南地，栽种各样结果子的树木，就要以所结的果子如未受割礼的一样。三年之久，你们要以这些果子，如未受割礼的，是不可吃的。
19.en: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

19.zh: 但第四年所结的果子全要成为圣，用以赞美耶和华。
19.en: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.

19.zh: 第五年，你们要吃那树上的果子，好叫树给你们结果子更多。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 「你们不可吃带血的物；不可用法术，也不可观兆。
19.en: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

19.zh: 头的周围不可剃，胡须的周围也不可损坏。
19.en: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

19.zh: 不可为死人用刀划身，也不可在身上刺花纹。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「不可辱没你的女儿，使她为娼妓，恐怕地上[的人]专向淫乱，地就满了大恶。
19.en: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

19.zh: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫术的；不可求问他们，以致被他们玷污了。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 「在白发的人面前，你要站起来；也要尊敬老人，又要敬畏你的　神。我是耶和华。
19.en: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.

19.zh: 「若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。
19.en: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

19.zh: 和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。我是耶和华—你们的　神。
19.en: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

19.zh: 「你们施行审判，不可行不义；在尺、秤、升、斗上也是如此。
19.en: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

19.zh: 要用公道天平、公道法码、公道升斗、公道秤。我是耶和华—你们的　神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来的。
19.en: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

19.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章。我是耶和华。」
19.en: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”

20.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
20.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

20.zh: 「你还要晓谕以色列人说：凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，总要治死他；本地人要用石头把他打死。
20.en: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

20.zh: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除；因为他把儿女献给摩洛，玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
20.en: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

20.zh: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地人若佯为不见，不把他治死，
20.en: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

20.zh: 我就要向这人和他的家变脸，把他和一切随他与摩洛行邪淫的人都从民中剪除。
20.en: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

20.zh: 「人偏向交鬼的和行巫术的，随他们行邪淫，我要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
20.en: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

20.zh: 所以你们要自洁成圣，因为我是耶和华—你们的　神。
20.en: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.

20.zh: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例；我是叫你们成圣的耶和华。
20.en: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.

20.zh: 凡咒骂父母的，总要治死他；他咒骂了父母，他的罪要归到他身上。
20.en: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

20.zh: 「与邻舍之妻行淫的，奸夫淫妇都必治死。
20.en: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

20.zh: 与继母行淫的，就是羞辱了他父亲，总要把他们二人治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

20.zh: 与儿妇同房的，总要把他们二人治死；他们行了逆伦的事，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

20.zh: 人若与男人苟合，像与女人一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

20.zh: 人若娶妻，并娶其母，便是大恶，要把这三人用火焚烧，使你们中间免去大恶。
20.en: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

20.zh: 人若与兽淫合，总要治死他，也要杀那兽。
20.en: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

20.zh: 女人若与兽亲近，与它淫合，你要杀那女人和那兽，总要把他们治死，罪要归到他们身上。
20.en: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

20.zh: 「人若娶他的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，是异父同母的，彼此见了下体，这是可耻的事；他们必在本民的眼前被剪除。他露了姊妹的下体，必担当自己的罪孽。
20.en: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

20.zh: 妇人有月经，若与她同房，露了她的下体，就是露了妇人的血源，妇人也露了自己的血源，二人必从民中剪除。
20.en: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

20.zh: 不可露姨母或是姑母的下体，这是露了骨肉之亲的下体；二人必担当自己的罪孽。
20.en: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

20.zh: 人若与伯叔之妻同房，就羞辱了他的伯叔；二人要担当自己的罪，必无子女而死。
20.en: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

20.zh: 人若娶弟兄之妻，这本是污秽的事，羞辱了他的弟兄；二人必无子女。
20.en: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

20.zh: 「所以，你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例典章，免得我领你们去住的那地把你们吐出。
20.en: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

20.zh: 我在你们面前所逐出的国民，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切的事，所以我厌恶他们。
20.en: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

20.zh: 但我对你们说过，你们要承受他们的地，就是我要赐给你们为业、流奶与蜜之地。我是耶和华—你们的　神，使你们与万民有分别的。
20.en: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

20.zh: 所以，你们要把洁净和不洁净的禽兽分别出来；不可因我给你们分为不洁净的禽兽，或是滋生在地上的活物，使自己成为可憎恶的。
20.en: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

20.zh: 你们要归我为圣，因为我—耶和华是圣的，并叫你们与万民有分别，使你们作我的民。
20.en: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

20.zh: 「无论男女，是交鬼的或行巫术的，总要治死他们。人必用石头把他们打死，罪要归到他们身上。」
20.en: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：「你告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的说：祭司不可为民中的死人沾染自己，
21.en: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

21.zh: 除非为他骨肉之亲的父母、儿女、弟兄，
21.en: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

21.zh: 和未曾出嫁、作处女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。
21.en: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

21.zh: 祭司既在民中为首，就不可从俗沾染自己。
21.en: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

21.zh: 不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，也不可用刀划身。
21.en: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

21.zh: 要归　神为圣，不可亵渎　神的名；因为耶和华的火祭，就是　神的食物，是他们献的，所以他们要成为圣。
21.en: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

21.zh: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人为妻，也不可娶被休的妇人为妻，因为祭司是归　神为圣。
21.en: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

21.zh: 所以你要使他成圣，因为他奉献你　神的食物；你要以他为圣，因为我—使你们成圣的耶和华—是圣的。
21.en: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

21.zh: 祭司的女儿若行淫辱没自己，就辱没了父亲，必用火将她焚烧。
21.en: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

21.zh: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、头上倒了膏油、又承接圣职、穿了[圣]衣的，不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。
21.en: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

21.zh: 不可挨近死尸，也不可为父母沾染自己。
21.en: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

21.zh: 不可出圣所，也不可亵渎　神的圣所，因为　神膏油的冠冕在他头上。我是耶和华。
21.en: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

21.zh: 他要娶处女为妻。
21.en: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

21.zh: 寡妇或是被休的妇人，或是被污为妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的处女为妻。
21.en: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

21.zh: 不可在民中辱没他的儿女，因为我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」
21.en: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

21.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
21.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

21.zh: 「你告诉亚伦说：你世世代代的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来献他　神的食物。
21.en: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

21.zh: 因为凡有残疾的，无论是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢体有余的、
21.en: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

21.zh: 折脚折手的、
21.en: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

21.zh: 驼背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、长癣的、长疥的，或是损坏肾子的，都不可近前来。
21.en: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

21.zh: 祭司亚伦的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来，将火祭献给耶和华。他有残疾，不可近前来献　神的食物。
21.en: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

21.zh: 神的食物，无论是圣的，至圣的，他都可以吃。
21.en: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

21.zh: 但不可进到幔子前，也不可就近坛前；因为他有残疾，免得亵渎我的圣所。我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」
21.en: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

21.zh: 于是，摩西晓谕亚伦和亚伦的子孙，并以色列众人。
21.en: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

22.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
22.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

22.zh: 「你吩咐亚伦和他子孙说：要远离以色列人所分别为圣、归给我的圣物，免得亵渎我的圣名。我是耶和华。
22.en: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

22.zh: 你要对他们说：你们世世代代的后裔，凡身上有污秽、亲近以色列人所分别为圣、归耶和华圣物的，那人必在我面前剪除。我是耶和华。
22.en: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.

22.zh: 亚伦的后裔，凡长大麻风的，或是有漏症的，不可吃圣物，直等他洁净了。无论谁摸那因死尸不洁净的物，或是遗精的人，
22.en: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

22.zh: 或是摸什么使他不洁净的爬物，或是摸那使他不洁净的人（不拘那人有什么不洁净），
22.en: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

22.zh: 摸了这些人、物的，必不洁净到晚上；若不用水洗身，就不可吃圣物。
22.en: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

22.zh: 日落的时候，他就洁净了，然后可以吃圣物，因为这是他的食物。
22.en: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

22.zh: 自死的或是被野兽撕裂的，他不可吃，因此污秽自己。我是耶和华。
22.en: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.

22.zh: 所以他们要守我所吩咐的，免得轻忽了，因此担罪而死。我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。
22.en: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

22.zh: 「凡外人不可吃圣物；寄居在祭司家的，或是雇工人，都不可吃圣物；
22.en: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

22.zh: 倘若祭司买人，是他的钱买的，那人就可以吃圣物；生在他家的人也可以吃。
22.en: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

22.zh: 祭司的女儿若嫁外人，就不可吃举祭的圣物。
22.en: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

22.zh: 但祭司的女儿若是寡妇，或是被休的，没有孩子，又归回父家，与她青年一样，就可以吃她父亲的食物；只是外人不可吃。
22.en: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

22.zh: 若有人误吃了圣物，要照圣物的原数加上五分之一交给祭司。
22.en: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

22.zh: 祭司不可亵渎以色列人所献给耶和华的圣物，
22.en: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

22.zh: 免得他们在吃圣物上自取罪孽，因为我是叫他们成圣的耶和华。」
22.en: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

22.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
22.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

22.zh: 「你晓谕亚伦和他子孙，并以色列众人说：以色列家中的人，或在以色列中寄居的，凡献供物，无论是所许的愿，是甘心献的，就是献给耶和华作燔祭的，
22.en: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:

22.zh: 要将没有残疾的公牛，或是绵羊，或是山羊[献上]，如此方蒙悦纳。
22.en: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

22.zh: 凡有残疾的，你们不可献上，因为这不蒙悦纳。
22.en: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

22.zh: 凡从牛群或是羊群中，将平安祭献给耶和华，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心献的，所献的必纯全无残疾的才蒙悦纳。
22.en: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

22.zh: 瞎眼的、折伤的、残废的、有瘤子的、长癣的、长疥的都不可献给耶和华，也不可在坛上作为火祭献给耶和华。
22.en: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

22.zh: 无论是公牛是绵羊羔，若肢体有余的，或是缺少的，只可作甘心祭献上；用以还愿，却不蒙悦纳。
22.en: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

22.zh: 肾子损伤的，或是压碎的，或是破裂的，或是骟了的，不可献给耶和华，在你们的地上也不可[这样]行。
22.en: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

22.zh: 这类的物，你们从外人的手，一样也不可接受作你们　神的食物献上；因为这些都有损坏，有残疾，不蒙悦纳。」
22.en: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

22.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
22.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

22.zh: 「才生的公牛，或是绵羊或是山羊，七天当跟着母；从第八天以后，可以当供物蒙悦纳，作为耶和华的火祭。
22.en: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

22.zh: 无论是母牛是母羊，不可同日宰母和子。
22.en: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

22.zh: 你们献感谢祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
22.en: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

22.zh: 要当天吃，一点不可留到早晨。我是耶和华。
22.en: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.

22.zh: 「你们要谨守遵行我的诫命。我是耶和华。
22.en: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.

22.zh: 你们不可亵渎我的圣名；我在以色列人中，却要被尊为圣。我是叫你们成圣的耶和华，
22.en: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,

22.zh: 把你们从埃及地领出来，作你们的　神。我是耶和华。」
22.en: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

23.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：耶和华的节期，你们要宣告为圣会的节期。
23.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

23.zh: 六日要做工，第七日是圣安息日，当有圣会；你们什么工都不可做。这是在你们一切的住处向耶和华守的安息日。
23.en: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

23.zh: 耶和华的节期，就是你们到了日期要宣告为圣会的，乃是这些。」
23.en: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

23.zh: 「正月十四日，黄昏的时候，是耶和华的逾越节。
23.en: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

23.zh: 这月十五日是向耶和华守的无酵节；你们要吃无酵饼七日。
23.en: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

23.zh: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做；
23.en: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

23.zh: 要将火祭献给耶和华七日。第七日是圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」
23.en: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

23.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我赐给你们的地，收割庄稼的时候，要将初熟的庄稼一捆带给祭司。
23.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

23.zh: 他要把这一捆在耶和华面前摇一摇，使你们得蒙悦纳。祭司要在安息日的次日把这捆摇一摇。
23.en: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

23.zh: 摇这捆的日子，你们要把一岁、没有残疾的公绵羊羔献给耶和华为燔祭。
23.en: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

23.zh: 同献的素祭，就是调油的细面[伊法]十分之二，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。同献的奠祭，要酒一欣四分之一。
23.en: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

23.zh: 无论是饼，是烘的子粒，是新穗子，你们都不可吃，直等到把你们献给　神的供物带来的那一天才可以吃。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。」
23.en: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

23.zh: 「你们要从安息日的次日，献禾捆为摇祭的那日算起，要满了七个安息日。
23.en: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

23.zh: 到第七个安息日的次日，共计五十天，又要将新素祭献给耶和华。
23.en: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

23.zh: 要从你们的住处取出细面[伊法]十分之二，加酵，烤成两个摇祭的饼，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
23.en: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

23.zh: 又要将一岁、没有残疾的羊羔七只、公牛犊一只、公绵羊两只，和饼一同奉上。这些与同献的素祭和奠祭要作为燔祭献给耶和华，就是作馨香的火祭献给耶和华。
23.en: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

23.zh: 你们要献一只公山羊为赎罪祭，两只一岁的公绵羊羔为平安祭。
23.en: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

23.zh: 祭司要把这些和初熟[麦子做]的饼一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这是献与耶和华为圣物归给祭司的。
23.en: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

23.zh: 当这日，你们要宣告圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

23.zh: 「在你们的地收割庄稼，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取所遗落的；要留给穷人和寄居的。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
23.en: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

23.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：七月初一，你们要守为圣安息日，要吹角作纪念，当有圣会。
23.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

23.zh: 什么劳碌的工都不可做；要将火祭献给耶和华。」
23.en: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

23.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
23.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

23.zh: 「七月初十是赎罪日；你们要守为圣会，并要刻苦己心，也要将火祭献给耶和华。
23.en: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

23.zh: 当这日，什么工都不可做；因为是赎罪日，要在耶和华—你们的　神面前赎罪。
23.en: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

23.zh: 当这日，凡不刻苦己心的，必从民中剪除。
23.en: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

23.zh: 凡这日做什么工的，我必将他从民中除灭。
23.en: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

23.zh: 你们什么工都不可做。这在你们一切的住处作为世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

23.zh: 你们要守这日为圣安息日，并要刻苦己心。从这月初九日晚上到[次日]晚上，要守为安息日。」
23.en: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

23.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
23.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

23.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：这七月十五日是住棚节，要在耶和华面前守这节七日。
23.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

23.zh: 第一日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。
23.en: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

23.zh: 七日内要将火祭献给耶和华。第八日当守圣会，要将火祭献给耶和华。这是严肃会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。
23.en: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

23.zh: 「这是耶和华的节期，就是你们要宣告为圣会的节期；要将火祭、燔祭、素祭、祭物，并奠祭，各归各日，献给耶和华。
23.en: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

23.zh: 这是在耶和华的安息日以外，又在你们的供物和所许的愿，并甘心献给耶和华的以外。
23.en: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

23.zh: 「你们收藏了地的出产，就从七月十五日起，要守耶和华的节七日。第一日为圣安息；第八日也为圣安息。
23.en: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

23.zh: 第一日要拿美好树上的果子和棕树上的枝子，与茂密树的枝条并河旁的柳枝，在耶和华—你们的　神面前欢乐七日。
23.en: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

23.zh: 每年七月间，要向耶和华守这节七日。这为你们世世代代永远的定例。
23.en: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

23.zh: 你们要住在棚里七日；凡以色列家的人都要住在棚里，
23.en: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

23.zh: 好叫你们世世代代知道，我领以色列人出埃及地的时候曾使他们住在棚里。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
23.en: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

23.zh: 于是，摩西将耶和华的节期传给以色列人。
23.en: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

24.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
24.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

24.zh: 「要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点着。
24.en: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

24.zh: 在会幕中法[柜]的幔子外，亚伦从晚上到早晨必在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
24.en: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

24.zh: 他要在耶和华面前常收拾精[金]灯台上的灯。」
24.en: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

24.zh: 「你要取细面，烤成十二个饼，每饼用面[伊法]十分之二。
24.en: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

24.zh: 要把饼摆列两行，每行六个，在耶和华面前精[金]的桌子上；
24.en: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

24.zh: 又要把净乳香放在每行饼上，作为纪念，就是作为火祭献给耶和华。
24.en: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

24.zh: 每安息日要常摆在耶和华面前；这为以色列人作永远的约。
24.en: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

24.zh: 这饼是要给亚伦和他子孙的；他们要在圣处吃，为永远的定例，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中是至圣的。」
24.en: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

24.zh: 有一个以色列妇人的儿子，他父亲是埃及人，[一日]闲游在以色列人中。这以色列妇人的儿子和一个以色列人在营里争斗。
24.en: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

24.zh: 这以色列妇人的儿子亵渎了[圣]名，并且咒诅，就有人把他送到摩西那里。（他母亲名叫示罗密，是但支派底伯利的女儿。）
24.en: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

24.zh: 他们把那人收在监里，要得耶和华所指示的话。
24.en: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

24.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
24.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

24.zh: 「把那咒诅[圣名]的人带到营外。叫听见的人都放手在他头上；全会众就要用石头打死他。
24.en: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

24.zh: 你要晓谕以色列人说：凡咒诅　神的，必担当他的罪。
24.en: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

24.zh: 那亵渎耶和华名的，必被治死；全会众总要用石头打死他。不管是寄居的是本地人，他亵渎[耶和华]名的时候，必被治死。
24.en: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

24.zh: 打死人的，必被治死；
24.en: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

24.zh: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜，以命偿命。
24.en: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

24.zh: 人若使他邻舍的身体有残疾，他怎样行，也要照样向他行：
24.en: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

24.zh: 以伤还伤，以眼还眼，以牙还牙。他怎样叫人的身体有残疾，也要照样向他行。
24.en: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

24.zh: 打死牲畜的，必赔上牲畜；打死人的，必被治死。
24.en: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

24.zh: 不管是寄居的是本地人，同归一例。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
24.en: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

24.zh: 于是，摩西晓谕以色列人，他们就把那咒诅[圣名]的人带到营外，用石头打死。以色列人就照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
24.en: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

25.zh: 耶和华在西奈山对摩西说：
25.en: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

25.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐你们那地的时候，地就要向耶和华守安息。
25.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

25.zh: 六年要耕种田地，也要修理葡萄园，收藏地的出产。
25.en: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

25.zh: 第七年，地要守圣安息，就是向耶和华守的安息，不可耕种田地，也不可修理葡萄园。
25.en: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

25.zh: 遗落自长的庄稼不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取葡萄。这年，地要守圣安息。
25.en: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

25.zh: 地在安息年所出的，要给你和你的仆人、婢女、雇工人，并寄居的外人当食物。
25.en: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

25.zh: 这年的土产也要给你的牲畜和你地上的走兽当食物。」
25.en: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

25.zh: 「你要计算七个安息年，就是七七年。这便为你成了七个安息年，共是四十九年。
25.en: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

25.zh: 当年七月初十日，你要大发角声；这日就是赎罪日，要在遍地发出角声。
25.en: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

25.zh: 第五十年，你们要当作圣年，在遍地给一切的居民宣告自由。这年必为你们的禧年，各人要归自己的产业，各归本家。
25.en: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

25.zh: 第五十年要作为你们的禧年。这年不可耕种；地中自长的，不可收割；没有修理的葡萄树也不可摘取[葡萄]。
25.en: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

25.zh: 因为这是禧年，你们要当作圣年，吃地中[自出]的土产。
25.en: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

25.zh: 「这禧年，你们各人要归自己的地业。
25.en: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

25.zh: 你若卖什么给邻舍，或是从邻舍的手中买什么，彼此不可亏负。
25.en: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

25.zh: 你要按禧年以后的年数向邻舍买；他也要按年数的收成卖给你。
25.en: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

25.zh: 年岁若多，要照数加添价值；年岁若少，要照数减去价值，因为他照收成的数目卖给你。
25.en: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

25.zh: 你们彼此不可亏负，只要敬畏你们的　神，因为我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
25.en: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

25.zh: 「我的律例，你们要遵行，我的典章，你们要谨守，就可以在那地上安然居住。
25.en: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

25.zh: 地必出土产，你们就要吃饱，在那地上安然居住。
25.en: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

25.zh: 你们若说：『这第七年我们不耕种，也不收藏土产，吃什么呢？』
25.en: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

25.zh: 我必在第六年将我所命的福赐给你们，地便生三年的土产。
25.en: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

25.zh: 第八年，你们要耕种，也要吃陈粮，等到第九年出产收来的时候，你们还吃陈粮。」
25.en: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

25.zh: 「地不可永卖，因为地是我的；你们在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。
25.en: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

25.zh: 在你们所得为业的全地，也要准人将地赎回。
25.en: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

25.zh: 你的弟兄若渐渐穷乏，卖了几分地业，他至近的亲属就要来把弟兄所卖的赎回。
25.en: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

25.zh: 若没有能给他赎回的，他自己渐渐富足，能够赎回，
25.en: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

25.zh: 就要算出卖地的年数，把余剩年数的价值还那买主，自己便归回自己的地业。
25.en: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

25.zh: 倘若不能为自己得回所卖的，仍要存在买主的手里直到禧年；到了禧年，地业要出[买主的手]，自己便归回自己的地业。
25.en: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

25.zh: 「人若卖城内的住宅，卖了以后，一年之内可以赎回；在一整年，必有赎回的权柄。
25.en: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

25.zh: 若在一整年之内不赎回，这城内的房屋就定准永归买主，世世代代为业；在禧年也不得出[买主的手]。
25.en: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

25.zh: 但房屋在无城墙的村庄里，要看如乡下的田地一样，可以赎回；到了禧年，都要出[买主的手]。
25.en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

25.zh: 然而利未人所得为业的城邑，其中的房屋，利未人可以随时赎回。
25.en: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

25.zh: 若是一个利未人不将所卖的房屋赎回，是在所得为业的城内，到了禧年就要出[买主的手]，因为利未人城邑的房屋是他们在以色列人中的产业。
25.en: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

25.zh: 只是他们各城郊野之地不可卖，因为是他们永远的产业。」
25.en: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

25.zh: 「你的弟兄在你那里若渐渐贫穷，手中缺乏，你就要帮补他，使他与你同住，像外人和寄居的一样。
25.en: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

25.zh: 不可向他取利，也不可向他多要；只要敬畏你的　神，使你的弟兄与你同住。
25.en: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

25.zh: 你借钱给他，不可向他取利；借粮给他，也不可向他多要。
25.en: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

25.zh: 我是耶和华—你们的　神，曾领你们从埃及地出来，为要把迦南地赐给你们，要作你们的　神。」
25.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

25.zh: 「你的弟兄若在你那里渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给你，不可叫他像奴仆服事你。
25.en: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

25.zh: 他要在你那里像雇工人和寄居的一样，要服事你直到禧年。
25.en: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

25.zh: 到了禧年，他和他儿女要离开你，一同出去归回本家，到他祖宗的地业那里去。
25.en: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

25.zh: 因为他们是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的，不可卖为奴仆。
25.en: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

25.zh: 不可严严地辖管他，只要敬畏你的　神。
25.en: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

25.zh: 至于你的奴仆、婢女，可以从你四围的国中买。
25.en: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

25.zh: 并且那寄居在你们中间的外人和他们的家属，在你们地上所生的，你们也可以从其中买人；他们要作你们的产业。
25.en: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

25.zh: 你们要将他们遗留给你们的子孙为产业，要永远从他们中间拣出奴仆；只是你们的弟兄以色列人，你们不可严严地辖管。
25.en: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

25.zh: 「住在你那里的外人，或是寄居的，若渐渐富足，你的弟兄却渐渐穷乏，将自己卖给那外人，或是寄居的，或是外人的宗族，
25.en: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

25.zh: 卖了以后，可以将他赎回。无论是他的弟兄，
25.en: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

25.zh: 或伯叔、伯叔的儿子，本家的近支，都可以赎他。他自己若渐渐富足，也可以自赎。
25.en: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

25.zh: 他要和买主计算，从卖自己的那年起，算到禧年；所卖的价值照着年数多少，好像工人每年的工价。
25.en: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

25.zh: 若缺少的年数多，就要按着年数从买价中偿还他的赎价。
25.en: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

25.zh: 若到禧年只缺少几年，就要按着年数和买主计算，偿还他的赎价。
25.en: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

25.zh: 他和买主同住，要像每年雇的工人，买主不可严严地辖管他。
25.en: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

25.zh: 他若不这样被赎，到了禧年，要和他的儿女一同出去。
25.en: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

25.zh: 因为以色列人都是我的仆人，是我从埃及地领出来的。我是耶和华—你们的　神。」
25.en: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

26.zh: 「你们不可做什么虚无的神[像]，不可立雕刻的偶像或是柱像，也不可在你们的地上安什么錾成的石像，向它跪拜，因为我是耶和华—你们的　神。
26.en: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.

26.zh: 你们要守我的安息日，敬我的圣所。我是耶和华。
26.en: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

26.zh: 「你们若遵行我的律例，谨守我的诫命，
26.en: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

26.zh: 我就给你们降下时雨，叫地生出土产，田野的树木结果子。
26.en: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

26.zh: 你们打粮食要打到摘葡萄的时候，摘葡萄要摘到撒种的时候；并且要吃得饱足，在你们的地上安然居住。
26.en: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

26.zh: 我要赐平安在[你们的]地上；你们躺卧，无人惊吓。我要叫恶兽从[你们的]地上息灭；刀剑也必不经过你们的地。
26.en: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

26.zh: 你们要追赶仇敌，他们必倒在你们刀下。
26.en: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

26.zh: 你们五个人要追赶一百人，一百人要追赶一万人；仇敌必倒在你们刀下。
26.en: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

26.zh: 我要眷顾你们，使你们生养众多，也要与你们坚定所立的约。
26.en: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

26.zh: 你们要吃陈粮，又因新粮挪开陈粮。
26.en: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

26.zh: 我要在你们中间立我的帐幕；我的心也不厌恶你们。
26.en: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

26.zh: 我要在你们中间行走；我要作你们的　神，你们要作我的子民。
26.en: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

26.zh: 我是耶和华—你们的　神，曾将你们从埃及地领出来，使你们不作埃及人的奴仆；我也折断你们所负的轭，叫你们挺身而走。」
26.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

26.zh: 「你们若不听从我，不遵行我的诫命，
26.en: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

26.zh: 厌弃我的律例，厌恶我的典章，不遵行我一切的诫命，背弃我的约，
26.en: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

26.zh: 我待你们就要这样：我必命定惊惶，叫眼目干瘪、精神消耗的痨病热病辖制你们。你们也要白白地撒种，因为仇敌要吃你们所种的。
26.en: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

26.zh: 我要向你们变脸，你们就要败在仇敌面前。恨恶你们的，必辖管你们；无人追赶，你们却要逃跑。
26.en: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

26.zh: 你们因这些事若还不听从我，我就要为你们的罪加七倍惩罚你们。
26.en: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

26.zh: 我必断绝你们因势力而有的骄傲，又要使[覆]你们的天如铁，[载]你们的地如铜。
26.en: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

26.zh: 你们要白白地劳力；因为你们的地不出土产，其上的树木也不结果子。
26.en: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

26.zh: 「你们行事若与我反对，不肯听从我，我就要按你们的罪加七倍降灾与你们。
26.en: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

26.zh: 我也要打发野地的走兽到你们中间，抢吃你们的儿女，吞灭你们的牲畜，使你们的人数减少，道路荒凉。
26.en: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

26.zh: 「你们因这些事若仍不改正归我，行事与我反对，
26.en: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

26.zh: 我就要行事与你们反对，因你们的罪击打你们七次。
26.en: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

26.zh: 我又要使刀剑临到你们，报复你们背约的仇；聚集你们在各城内，降瘟疫在你们中间，也必将你们交在仇敌的手中。
26.en: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

26.zh: 我要折断你们的杖，就是断绝你们的粮。那时，必有十个女人在一个炉子给你们烤饼，按分量秤给你们；你们要吃，也吃不饱。
26.en: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

26.zh: 「你们因这一切的事若不听从我，却行事与我反对，
26.en: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

26.zh: 我就要发烈怒，行事与你们反对，又因你们的罪惩罚你们七次。
26.en: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

26.zh: 并且你们要吃儿子的肉，也要吃女儿的肉。
26.en: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

26.zh: 我又要毁坏你们的邱坛，砍下你们的日像，把你们的尸首扔在你们偶像的身上；我的心也必厌恶你们。
26.en: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

26.zh: 我要使你们的城邑变为荒凉，使你们的众圣所成为荒场；我也不闻你们馨香的香气。
26.en: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

26.zh: 我要使地成为荒场，住在其上的仇敌就因此诧异。
26.en: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

26.zh: 我要把你们散在列邦中；我也要拔刀追赶你们。你们的地要成为荒场；你们的城邑要变为荒凉。
26.en: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

26.zh: 「你们在仇敌之地居住的时候，你们的地荒凉，要享受众安息；正在那时候，地要歇息，享受安息。
26.en: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

26.zh: 地多时为荒场，就要多时歇息；地这样歇息，是你们住在其上的安息年所不能得的。
26.en: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

26.zh: 至于你们剩下的人，我要使他们在仇敌之地心惊胆怯。叶子被风吹的响声，要追赶他们；他们要逃避，像人逃避刀剑，无人追赶，却要跌倒。
26.en: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

26.zh: 无人追赶，他们要彼此撞跌，像在刀剑之前。你们在仇敌面前也必站立不住。
26.en: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

26.zh: 你们要在列邦中灭亡；仇敌之地要吞吃你们。
26.en: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

26.zh: 你们剩下的人必因自己的罪孽和祖宗的罪孽在仇敌之地消灭。
26.en: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

26.zh: 「他们要承认自己的罪和他们祖宗的罪，就是干犯我的那罪，并且承认自己行事与我反对，
26.en: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

26.zh: 我所以行事与他们反对，把他们带到仇敌之地。那时，他们未受割礼的心若谦卑了，他们也服了罪孽的刑罚，
26.en: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

26.zh: 我就要记念我与雅各所立的约，与以撒所立的约，与亚伯拉罕所立的约，并要记念这地。
26.en: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

26.zh: 他们离开这地，地在荒废无人的时候就要享受安息。并且他们要服罪孽的刑罚；因为他们厌弃了我的典章，心中厌恶了我的律例。
26.en: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

26.zh: 虽是这样，他们在仇敌之地，我却不厌弃他们，也不厌恶他们，将他们尽行灭绝，也不背弃我与他们所立的约，因为我是耶和华—他们的　神。
26.en: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

26.zh: 我却要为他们的缘故记念我与他们先祖所立的约。他们的先祖是我在列邦人眼前、从埃及地领出来的，为要作他们的　神。我是耶和华。」
26.en: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”

26.zh: 这些律例、典章，和法度是耶和华与以色列人在西奈山借着摩西立的。
26.en: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

27.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：
27.en: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

27.zh: 「你晓谕以色列人说：人还特许的愿，被许的人要按你所估的价值归给耶和华。
27.en: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,

27.zh: 你估定的，从二十岁到六十岁的男人，要按圣所的平，估定价银五十舍客勒。
27.en: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

27.zh: 若是女人，你要估定三十舍客勒。
27.en: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

27.zh: 若是从五岁到二十岁，男子你要估定二十舍客勒，女子估定十舍客勒。
27.en: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

27.zh: 若是从一月到五岁，男子你要估定五舍客勒，女子估定三舍客勒。
27.en: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

27.zh: 若是从六十岁以上，男人你要估定十五舍客勒，女人估定十舍客勒。
27.en: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

27.zh: 他若贫穷，不能照你所估定的价，就要把他带到祭司面前，祭司要按许愿人的力量估定他的价。
27.en: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

27.zh: 「[所许的]若是牲畜，就是人献给耶和华为供物的，凡这一类献给耶和华的，都要成为圣。
27.en: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.

27.zh: 人不可改换，也不可更换，或是好的换坏的，或是坏的换好的。若以牲畜更换牲畜，所许的与所换的都要成为圣。
27.en: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

27.zh: 若牲畜不洁净，是不可献给耶和华为供物的，就要把牲畜安置在祭司面前。
27.en: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

27.zh: 祭司就要估定价值；牲畜是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为是。
27.en: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

27.zh: 他若一定要赎回，就要在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一。
27.en: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

27.zh: 「人将房屋分别为圣，归给耶和华，祭司就要估定价值。房屋是好是坏，祭司怎样估定，就要以怎样为定。
27.en: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

27.zh: 将房屋分别为圣的人，若要赎回房屋，就必在你所估定的价值以外加上五分之一，房屋仍旧归他。
27.en: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

27.zh: 「人若将承受为业的几分地分别为圣，归给耶和华，你要按这地撒种多少估定价值，若撒大麦一贺梅珥，[要估]价五十舍客勒。
27.en: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

27.zh: 他若从禧年将地分别为圣，就要以你所估定的价为定。
27.en: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

27.zh: 倘若他在禧年以后将地分别为圣，祭司就要按着未到禧年所剩的年数推算价值，也要从你所估的减去价值。
27.en: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

27.zh: 将地分别为圣的人若定要把地赎回，他便要在你所估的价值以外加上五分之一，地就准定归他。
27.en: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

27.zh: 他若不赎回那地，或是将地卖给别人，就再不能赎了。
27.en: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

27.zh: 但到了禧年，那地从[买主手下]出来的时候，就要归耶和华为圣，和永献的地一样，要归祭司为业。
27.en: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

27.zh: 他若将所买的一块地，不是承受为业的，分别为圣归给耶和华，
27.en: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

27.zh: 祭司就要将你所估的价值给他推算到禧年。当日，他要以你所估的价银为圣，归给耶和华。
27.en: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.

27.zh: 到了禧年，那地要归卖主，就是那承受为业的原主。
27.en: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

27.zh: 凡你所估定的价银都要按着圣所的平：二十季拉为一舍客勒。
27.en: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

27.zh: 「惟独牲畜中头生的，无论是牛是羊，既归耶和华，谁也不可再分别为圣，因为这是耶和华的。
27.en: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.

27.zh: 若是不洁净的牲畜生的，就要按你所估定的价值加上五分之一赎回；若不赎回，就要按你所估定的价值卖了。
27.en: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

27.zh: 「但一切永献的，就是人从他所有永献给耶和华的，无论是人，是牲畜，是他承受为业的地，都不可卖，也不可赎。凡永献的是归给耶和华为至圣。
27.en: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.

27.zh: 凡从人中当灭的都不可赎，必被治死。」
27.en: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

27.zh: 「地上所有的，无论是地上的种子是树上的果子，十分之一是耶和华的，是归给耶和华为圣的。
27.en: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.

27.zh: 人若要赎这十分之一的什么物，就要加上五分之一。
27.en: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

27.zh: 凡牛群羊群中，一切从杖下经过的，每第十只要归给耶和华为圣。
27.en: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

27.zh: 不可问是好是坏，也不可更换；若定要更换，所更换的与本来的牲畜都要成为圣，不可赎回。」
27.en: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

27.zh: 这就是耶和华在西奈山为以色列人所吩咐摩西的命令。
27.en: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
